segments.an5.218:1.3: Appasannā nappasīdanti, pasannānañca ekaccānaṃ aññathattaṃ hoti, satthusāsanaṃ akataṃ [na kataṃ (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, cittamassa nappasīdati.
segments.an5.218:1.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ādīnavā apāsādike.
segments.an5.218:2.3: Appasannā pasīdanti, pasannānañca bhiyyobhāvo hoti, satthusāsanaṃ kataṃ hoti, pacchimā janatā diṭṭhānugatiṃ āpajjati, cittamassa pasīdati.
segments.an5.218:2.4: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca ānisaṃsā pāsādike”ti.
